statement: Bi-Lipschitz coordinates at every regular RCD point. Proves that every regular point of a noncollapsed $`\mathop{\mathrm{RCD}}\nolimits (K,n)`$ space, for K ∈ ℝ and integer n ≥ 2, has an open neighborhood bi-Lipschitz to an open subset of ℝn. Regularity requires all pointed tangents to be Euclidean, the reference measure is exactly $`\mathcal H^n`$, and the chart compares ambient distances with a point-dependent finite constant.
